title: create-staging private config
description: Schema of the PRIVATE staging-tool configuration (~/.config/opencode/staging/config.json, mode 0600). Contains internal data by design — never commit a real config; extend this schema and the fictional example together.

baseUrl.description: Base URL of the web staging tool.

adapter.description: UI pilot adapter. Any API adapter is out of scope of v1.

adapterContract.description: Path or reference to the documented UI contract (private artifact).

resourcePrefix.description: Infra prefix added to the tool display name when absent (prefixing is idempotent: display 'foo' -> resource 'prefix-foo', display 'prefix-foo' -> resource 'prefix-foo').

stripBranchPrefixes.description: Branch prefixes stripped before slugging (feat/, fix/...).

maxLength.description: Max length of the tool Name field. The COMPILER truncates on a dash boundary — the field itself truncates silently.

repositories.description: Mapping 'git remote path' -> { projectKey, group }. projectKey = key of the project in the tool catalog.

bundles.description: Named feature bundles: which extra projects a staging needs beyond the locked core, and their branch policy (source = branch of the resolved source repo when the twin task exists, default = catalog default).

managedKeys.description: Exact set of variables the skill owns. fixed + derived + empty must partition managedKeys.

additionalProperties.description: Value template with {name} (tool display name) placeholder.

empty.description: Keys persisted with an empty value.

access.description: Access URLs reported in the FINAL summary (operator consumes these). {customerId} is a usage parameter, never a provisioning input.

homePattern.description: Manager/home URL template with {name} and {customerId} placeholders.

expectedVariableCount.description: Managed keys count the compiled plan must match exactly (pre-submit digest gate).

referenceStaging.description: Optional display name of a known-good staging used as an HTTP pattern reference.
